parameters.query:
SELECT json_build_object(
  'period_24h', (SELECT json_build_object('calls', count(*), 'cost', round(coalesce(sum(cost_usd),0)::numeric, 4), 'errors', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'ok')) FROM llm_calls WHERE occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL '24 hours'),
  'period_7d',  (SELECT json_build_object('calls', count(*), 'cost', round(coalesce(sum(cost_usd),0)::numeric, 4), 'errors', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'ok')) FROM llm_calls WHERE occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL '7 days'),
  'period_30d', (SELECT json_build_object('calls', count(*), 'cost', round(coalesce(sum(cost_usd),0)::numeric, 4), 'errors', count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'ok'), 'agents_active', count(DISTINCT agent_name)) FROM llm_calls WHERE occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'),
  'by_agent_30d', (SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.cost_30d DESC NULLS LAST) FROM (
    SELECT agent_name, count(*) AS calls_30d, round(coalesce(sum(cost_usd),0)::numeric, 4) AS cost_30d,
           count(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'ok') AS errors_30d,
           round(coalesce(avg(latency_ms),0)::numeric, 0) AS latency_ms_avg,
           sum(coalesce(tokens_in,0) + coalesce(tokens_out,0)) AS tokens_total,
           max(occurred_at) AS last_call_at
    FROM llm_calls WHERE occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    GROUP BY agent_name
  ) t),
  'by_model_30d', (SELECT json_agg(t.* ORDER BY t.cost_30d DESC) FROM (
    SELECT model, count(*) AS calls, round(coalesce(sum(cost_usd),0)::numeric, 4) AS cost_30d
    FROM llm_calls WHERE occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'
    GROUP BY model
  ) t),
  'unknown_agent_24h', (SELECT count(*) FROM llm_calls WHERE occurred_at > now() - INTERVAL '24 hours' AND agent_name IN ('unknown_agent', 'unknown', ''))
) AS report;
